# hls.js

Vendored hls.js 1.6.16 browser bundle, fetched from
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hls.js@1.6.16/dist/hls.min.js.
License: Apache-2.0. Upstream notices are included as `hls-LICENSE`;
the full license is included as `Apache-2.0.txt`. Both are embedded as a
comment in the distributed browser bundle.

Served locally at `/hls.js` and loaded only for HLS playback on browsers without
native HLS support. No runtime CDN request is required. The upstream source-map
reference is omitted because source maps are not shipped. A license comment
is prepended to preserve notices in the server-embedded distribution.

Upstream: https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js
API: https://hlsjs.video-dev.org/api-docs/hls.js.hls
